'''Miles Smith Balanced Smiley Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Miles Smith]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Balanced Smiley Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Balanced Smiley Deck Smith DS 1997.txt |Download]]
